name: MiseOS Orchestra Media Kit
description: Metadata and publishing policy for Mise Orchestra media assets such as theme audio, launch visuals, and future docs-hub motion assets.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for committing binaries, changing asset rights, or publishing media externally.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for adding metadata entries and publishing destinations.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for metadata corrections and docs cleanup.

release.currentStrategy: Keep media metadata in registry; store binaries outside the bootstrap repo unless explicitly approved.
release.nextMilestone: Move theme and visual assets to a dedicated media-kit or GitHub Release asset lane.

answers.what: A metadata and policy layer for Mise Orchestra media assets.
answers.does: Tracks media assets without bloating the bootstrap repository with binaries.
answers.registry: Repository metadata artifact; future media package or release asset lane.
answers.changed: Added metadata for the uploaded Mise Orchestra theme audio while keeping the binary out of the repo.
answers.safe: Safe because it stores metadata only and requires review for binary publishing.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes, agents can read the media metadata and recommend publishing destinations.
